how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Rishikesh Research Assistant Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 07-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Rishikesh Research Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the Research Assistant position at AIIMS Rishikesh is 07 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: To be eligible, candidates must hold a science Graduate degree from a recognized university and possess at least one year of work experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 34,000, excluding admissible travel allowance.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for this government job opportunity?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. Ensure you send your complete application with all necessary documents before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the total number of vacancies for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Research Assistant position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the AIIMS Rishikesh Research Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a written examination followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Research Assistant position is a contractual role at AIIMS Rishikesh.

faq.question: Q9. Where is AIIMS Rishikesh located?
faq.answer: AIIMS Rishikesh is located in Rishikesh, Uttarakhand, with the pincode 249203.

faq.question: Q10. Are there any desirable qualifications for the Research Assistant role?
faq.answer: Yes, proficiency in computer applications (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint), statistical software, and good communication skills in Hindi and English are desirable.
